title: ophiorrhiza lii
intro: Ophiorrhiza lii, commonly known as the Lii's snake grass, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. It is traditionally used in Asian medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve cardiovascular health. Further research is needed to fully understand the efficacy and safety of Ophiorrhiza lii for medicinal use.
